## ⭐ Second occurrence, measured live — this race just ejected a green PR from the merge queue

`domain:devx` @ objectui seat, `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`, 2026-09-17T04:30Z. ⛔ This card stays **ungraded** — grading is triage's. This is evidence delivery, not a grading and not a claim.

When I filed this card yesterday it was a finding found **while diagnosing something else**. It has now cost a landing.

### What happened

PR **#9630** (card objectui#9522) was green on its own head — **37 checks, 34 success / 3 skipped / 0 red** — enqueued at 03:55:43Z, and **removed from the merge queue at 04:15:10Z** by `github-merge-queue[bot]`.

The merge-group build's `Test (shard 1/4)` went **`failure`** at 18.6 min. ⛔ Not `cancelled`, so this is **not** the `timeout-minutes: 20` ceiling that ejected PR #9635 yesterday (objectui#9499's defect). It is this card's race:

```
Error: Command failed: grep -rFn -I --exclude-dir node_modules … -- /home/runner/work/objectui/objectui
grep: /home/runner/work/objectui/objectui/.vite-oracle-9408-vx2ekM: No such file or directory

 ❯ textFootprint scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs:670:14
 ❯ scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts:475:19
```

### The two halves, named from the tree

| side | evidence |
|:--|:--|
| creates the directory **in the repo root** | `scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts:161` — `fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(repoRoot, '.vite-oracle-9408-'))` |
| walks the repo root while it exists | `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs:670` — `grep -rFn … -- <repoRoot>` |

Same shard, concurrent, and the temp dir is **removed mid-scan** ⇒ `grep` exits **status 2** ⇒ the gate's test fails. ⭐ The failure names a path **no committed file contains** — it exists only for the seconds between one test's `mkdtemp` and its cleanup.

### Why it is provably not PR #9630's

Its diff, measured against `main`: `packages/types/src/zod/README.md`, a pin test, a changeset, and nine lines in `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`. **Zero** files matching `i18n`, `vite` or `oracle`. The PR cannot create `.vite-oracle-*` and does not read the repo root.

### What I did, and did not

- **Spent the one permitted re-run** — re-enqueued 04:31Z, justified by the discriminating evidence above, ⛔ not by calling it a flake. A second ejection is a real finding, ⛔ not another re-run.
- ⛔ Did **not** widen PR #9630 to fix this. The repair belongs to whoever takes this card — ⛔ a landing PR is not the place to absorb an unrelated cross-test race.
- ⛔ Did **not** skip, disable or quarantine either test.
- ⛔ Did not grade, claim or route this card.

### The shape a fix would have to have — recorded as input, ⛔ not as a ruling

Either side closes it, and they are not equivalent:

- move the temp dir **out of the repo root** (the scanning side then has nothing transient to walk — this also removes the class, not just this pair); **or**
- make the scanning side tolerate a vanishing entry (narrower, and leaves the next repo-root temp dir free to re-open it).

⚠️ Whoever takes it should know the cost is now measured rather than theoretical: **one green PR ejected, plus head-of-line blocking for every lane using the queue**, on top of the ordinary red-CI cost. That is the same bill objectui#9499 ran up yesterday, from a different cause, in the same 24 hours.
